regions.merged_text: Non Catholic Seeks Blessing in S. M Assoc. Louise Ahrendt, non catholic heartsore about only daughter 25. Latter has not been with widowed mother for five years, comes to see her very seldom -- disapointed herself, seems unappreciative. Mother joins both for a year in S.M. Assoc. and before leaving monastery decides to take regular course of instruction. June 23 started regular in- struction.

regions.merged_text: "This is a Miracle." Thomas Buckley drinking, abusing wife beyond endurance. She decides to brake up house. Court decides it best to do so. "Wait, says a neighbor, "till I put your Husband in S.M. A. Maybe he would change." A week later the poor wife could hardly be- lieve the result. "It is like a dream" She acknowledges to her good neighbor (Miss Dolan) Thomas has become like a youthful lover." Thanks be to God!

regions.merged_text: Anthony Artale (48) 75 Wilber Ave S.L. City, Away from wife and family three years - not to confession for 17 years - since married. Sad to say when a boy and a youth had been frustrated in earnest efforts to be a priest. Even after marriage remained devoted to B. Mary Virgin. Enrolled to-day as beginning for perpetual 50¢ pd.
